description: About 300 of the search spike's 1,733 CC0 Kenney images, stratified across every category and pack. Images are fetched from the pack zips (url#path_in_pack) and never committed. By-look relevance is same pack and same category.

prompts.card-v1: Describe this game asset image in one or two plain sentences for a searchable card: what it shows, its subject, materials, colours and style. Do not mention a file name or an asset id.
